meanings.note: Casual, blunt contraction of あなた used between intimates or in heated speech.

meanings.en: go forward; work out well (いけます = 'it will work!')
meanings.note: Written in kana for figurative headway: いけます! ('this can go / this will work!'), 思いどおりにいかない ('does not go as hoped').

examples.text: この企画ならいけます！
examples.trans: With this plan, it will work!

examples.text: 仕事がうまくいっています。

meanings.note: Marks the presence of a person (責任者はいるか) or follows て-form (often contracted to てる/てます in speech).
Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

meanings.note: Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).

examples.text: 仕事のことを話します。

meanings.note: Standalone pronoun ('this'), unlike この which requires a noun.
Casual/intimate apology, often softened with な or ね.
Standard polite 'goodbye'.

そんな.gloss: such; that kind of; that much

meanings.note: Before たくさん, means 'that huge an amount'.

examples.text: そんな話は知りません。
examples.trans: I do not know such a story.

examples.text: そんな高いものは買えません。
examples.trans: I cannot buy something that expensive.

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Polite sentence-ending counterpart of plain だ.

cells: ではありません / じゃありません

meanings.note: Means 'spot' in 近いところ, and 'as far as today goes' in 今日のところは.

examples.text: 静かなところが好きです。
今のところは順調です。
examples.trans: For the moment, things are going smoothly.

meanings.note: Combines どう (how) + いう (say); どういうこと means 'what does this mean?'.

examples.trans: What is the meaning of this?

meanings.note: Interrogative pronoun for place.

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').
Everyday spoken counterpart of なぜ or どうして.

examples.text: なんで知っているんですか。

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).

meanings.en: as for; topic or contrast marker
meanings.note: Written は but pronounced wa when marking the topic or contrasting one item with another.
I-adjective describing behavior or appearance that is embarrassing.

examples.text: そんなことして、みっともない！
examples.trans: Doing something like that is shameful!

examples.text: みっともない真似はやめろ。

meanings.note: In もういい, means 'already enough' or 'ready now'.
Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.
Polite/dialectal negative ending, especially in ～ません.
Iconic Italian supercar popular in 1970s–80s Japan, including as toys and models.

examples.text: カウンタックはかっこいい。
カウンタックのラジコン。

meanings.note: Affectionate family word used by children and spouses at home.

examples.text: パパは料理が上手です。
日曜日はパパと出かけます。
examples.trans: On Sundays I go out with Dad.

meanings.note: Abbreviation of ラジオコントロール (radio control).

examples.text: 誕生日にラジコンを買ってもらいました。
examples.trans: I got an RC car for my birthday.

examples.text: 公園でラジコンを走らせます。
examples.trans: I run my RC car in the park.

meanings.note: Used among friends and peers by men; switch to 私 or 僕 in formal settings.
Plural of 俺 (おれ) with pluralizing suffix ら.

meanings.en: open a store; bring out; hand in
meanings.note: 店を出す means opening a branch; 出しやがって attaches tough-guy disdainful やがる.

examples.text: 駅前に新しい店を出します。
examples.trans: We open a new branch in front of the station.

examples.text: 書類を出してください。

meanings.note: In the idiom 口を出す, means 'to meddle / butt in'.
Used for social/work issues as well as test questions.

examples.text: それは大きな問題です。
特に問題はありません。

meanings.note: Na-adjective stem; 嫌だ! is a strong 'No! / I hate it!'.
Adverbial form 早く urges someone to hurry up.

examples.trans: I woke up early in the morning.

meanings.note: Familiar/direct way to address or refer to one's mother.
Noun derived from 終わる (to end).

examples.text: これで今日の授業は終わりです。
examples.trans: With this, today's class is over.
